# BitLogic

> BitLogic is a no-code crypto screener and alert app for iOS, Android and Windows, with a free web screener. It scans hundreds of coins on 11 exchanges against rules the user builds and sends matches as push notifications or Telegram messages. It does not place trades, hold funds or ask for exchange API keys, and it gives no financial advice.

Facts verified 7 October 2026 against BitLogic 1.0.38. Prices vary by country and are shown in the app and the store listing.

## Key facts
- Exchanges (11): Coinbase, Kraken, Binance, Binance.US, Bybit, OKX, KuCoin, Bitstamp, Upbit, VALR, CoinDCX
- Up to 400 trading pairs per scan; timeframes from 1 minute up to 1 week (depends on the exchange)
- 60+ technical indicators and 60+ candlestick patterns, AND/OR logic, long and short rules
- Free alert feeds on Binance Futures data: liquidations, funding rates, open interest, volume spikes, price moves
- Live monitoring: up to 5 monitors, alerts arrive with the app closed
- Free: scanning, alert feeds, strategy builder. Guests get 3 scans per 24 hours; a free account removes the limit
- BitLogic Pro: Telegram alerts, no ads, live monitors without an ad, priority support; US$4.99/month or US$49.99/year (2 months free); 14-day free trial

## Other BitLogic apps
- [BitLogic Backtester](https://bitlogic.info/backtester/): no-code backtesting for crypto and stocks with 60+ indicators, walk-forward optimizer, multi-market tests and paper trading. Windows now (Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NMV7F8CNQCQ); Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android coming soon. Free account: 3 backtests and 1 optimization; Week pass US$3.50; Monthly US$4.99 or Annual US$49.99 including BitLogic Pro.

## Guides
- [What is backtesting? Backtest stocks and crypto without coding](https://bitlogic.info/blog/what-is-backtesting-without-coding/): backtesting explained for stock and crypto traders, how the two markets differ, 6-step no-code walkthrough with BitLogic Backtester (Bitcoin and NVIDIA examples), key metrics, common mistakes and free backtesting tools compared
- [How much data and how many trades for backtesting](https://bitlogic.info/blog/how-much-data-and-trades-for-backtesting/): years of historical data by timeframe for stocks and crypto, data available per market, trade counts and margin of error, t-statistic luck check, pooling trades across markets
- [Why a backtest wins but loses live](https://bitlogic.info/blog/why-backtest-wins-but-loses-live/): backtest vs live results for stocks and crypto: overfitting and how to detect it, look-ahead bias and repainting, survivorship bias (delisted stocks and coins), fees, slippage, stamp duty, funding rates, liquidation and gaps, 7-step fix
- [What is a good win rate, profit factor, Sharpe ratio and drawdown](https://bitlogic.info/blog/good-win-rate-profit-factor-sharpe-drawdown/): benchmark table for backtest metrics, break-even win rate formula, why low win rates can be profitable, profit factor and Sharpe ranges, acceptable drawdown for stocks vs crypto, recovery math, real Bitcoin vs NVIDIA example
- [How to set stop-loss and take-profit, and which indicators work best](https://bitlogic.info/blog/stop-loss-take-profit-best-indicators/): fixed, ATR, swing-level, indicator and risk-reward stops, ATR stops for stocks vs crypto, position sizing from the stop, trailing stops, indicator families and combinations to backtest
- [Walk-forward and out-of-sample testing](https://bitlogic.info/blog/walk-forward-out-of-sample-testing/): in-sample vs out-of-sample, rolling vs anchored walk-forward, real walk-forward optimization example, how to run it without code, stocks vs crypto, red flags
- [Paper trading vs backtesting](https://bitlogic.info/blog/paper-trading-vs-backtesting/): what paper trading is, paper trading vs backtesting, which to do first, how long to paper trade, how to paper trade stocks and crypto on live prices, go-live checklist, paper trading app options and pricing
- [Crypto alerts for US traders](https://bitlogic.info/blog/crypto-alerts-for-us-traders/): how Binance Futures alerts and Binance.US scanning work from the US
- [Crypto liquidation alerts explained](https://bitlogic.info/blog/crypto-liquidation-alerts-explained/)
- [Funding rate alerts explained](https://bitlogic.info/blog/funding-rate-alerts-explained/)
- [Free TradingView alternative for crypto alerts](https://bitlogic.info/blog/free-tradingview-alternative-crypto-alerts/)
- [BitLogic vs TradingView vs 3Commas](https://bitlogic.info/blog/bitlogic-vs-tradingview-vs-3commas/)
